articles.title: Anthropic’s newest ad is creeping people out
articles.description: Anthropic has consistently attempted to depict itself as the ethical foil to other AI companies. This latest marketing stunt — which leans into criticism of AI as a way to make Anthropic seem aware of the responsibility it carries — would appear to be more of the same.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: The real AI race may no longer be at the frontier
articles.description: Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue says enterprises increasingly want open models, due to cost, accessibility, and ownership. Do frontier models still matter if most production AI ends up running on open models?
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Anthropic, Blackstone bet the next trillion-dollar AI business is implementation, not just models
articles.description: Anthropic-backed Ode launches as AI labs bet that embedding forward-deployed engineers inside enterprises is the key to accelerating enterprise AI adoption.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Anthropic’s landmark $1.5B copyright settlement is approved
articles.description: The final approval settles one case, but it doesn't resolve the broader issue of using copyrighted works to train AI models.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec

articles.title: Vint Cerf is working on a plan to unleash AI agents on the open internet
articles.description: The guy behind TCP/IP is working on a standard for identifying AI agents in the wild.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: The Zoom hack that says, ‘Don’t record me’
articles.description: If every meeting, watercooler conversation, and date gets transcribed and summarized, who's actually reading any of it?
articles.author: Connie Loizos

articles.title: Patreon stops asking AI bots not to scrape — and starts blocking them
articles.description: Patreon is strengthening its defenses against AI scraping by working with Cloudflare to block bots that train AI models on creators’ content without permission. The move marks a shift away from relying on websites using robots.txt alone to actively block unauthorized AI training.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Kimi: Threat or menace?
articles.description: Chinese company Moonshot AI released a new version of its Kimi model this week, prompting concern about "full AI communism."
articles.author: Anthony Ha

articles.title: Databricks hits $188B valuation, extending its run as AI’s favorite second act
articles.description: Databricks has remade its image into an AI company and has published research on the cost savings of open-weight AI models for coding.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Thinking Machines amps up its bet against one-size-fits-all AI with its first open model, Inkling
articles.description: It's the company's first public proof point after a year and a half spent building AI infrastructure largely out of public view.
articles.author: Connie Loizos
